description: Re-prices one stay for exact dates and guests and returns a ZMRM booking link that opens the stay with the same dates and guests pre-filled. The quote carries priced_at and valid_until (advisory, not a hold). Payment always happens in ZMRM checkout; this tool never books or charges.

agent.description: Your client's name (e.g. "chatgpt", "claude"), used only to attribute the visit; optional.

check_in.description: Arrival day, YYYY-MM-DD (Israel time). Today or later.

check_out.description: Departure day, YYYY-MM-DD, after check_in. get_search_options gives the longest stay (max_nights).

children.description: Number of children, not counting infants. Defaults to 0.

currency.description: Also show the price converted to EUR or USD (approximate). Prices are always quoted in ILS agorot; omit for ILS only.

id.description: The stay id (uuid) from search_stays or get_stay.

locale.description: Language of the returned names and of the stay links (he, en, fr, es, de, it, ru, ar). Defaults to he.

nationality.description: Lead guest's nationality, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in capitals (e.g. "IL", "US"). Some hotel rates depend on it. Defaults to IL.

pets.description: True when the guests bring a pet; it is filled into the stay link. It does not filter results: check house_rules.pets_allowed in get_stay.

name: get_booking_link
